problem:
The row echelon form matrix $A$ is given below. What are the pivot columns of $A?$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Identifying the Pivot Columns of a Matrix

examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Pivot Columns of a Matrix in Row Echelon Form
examples.problem:
The row echelon form matrix $B$ is given below. What are its pivot columns?
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14072258/assets/bc54c8852a673014f5bb9c7f3b7c07b5f2414d8edf0cea79e2b410211e97ae20.png)
examples.worked_solution:
Remember that the pivots of a matrix in row echelon form are the first non-zero entries in each row of the matrix.

We can see that $B$ has $3$ pivots in the $2$nd, $3$rd, and $4$th columns:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14072258/assets/c31f9eb258350b5f9cc63d2e96a3e68122428b64e097451d7b9a12a3b58750c3.png)
